checklist.text: Release script: self-contained win-x64 publish, zipped, no shortcuts
README: Windows only, play from the zip, build from source; Read Me First.txt has controls
Run Make Release Zip.bat: it finishes and the zip appears in "Birb Cube Release" (Nov 5)
Unzip to a new folder and double-click BirbCube.exe: game starts (Nov 5)
Zip size is reasonable (tell me if it is over ~250 MB)
Test on a PC without the .NET SDK or runtime (a friend's, or a clean VM)
Commit and push, then upload the zip to GitHub Releases

description: Self-contained win-x64 zip for friends, made by `Make Release Zip.bat` into "..\Birb Cube Release" (radio defaults and Read Me First.txt included, no music). You upload it by hand on GitHub Releases. Risks: the unsigned exe triggers SmartScreen (explained in Read Me First); cimgui.dll may need the VC++ redistributable on a clean PC.
title: Shareable download for friends
